units.source_text: 接着往推了约莫五六百米的距离，轨道再次到了坡度很陡的地方。

en.t: After they pushed on for roughly another five or six hundred meters, the track once again reached a very steep slope.

units.source_text: 这一代两旁都是蜜橘园，很多黄澄澄的果实沐浴在阳光下。

en.t: On both sides around here were mandarin orange orchards, and many golden-yellow fruits were basking in the sunlight.
